name: Working rules
summary: Seven short rules: read relevant line ranges, delegate only when a summary is enough, check narrowly then fully, filter long output without hiding errors, no unrequested work, concise prose that keeps caveats, suggest /clear on a task switch.

evidence.setting: mechanism only, no paired test of these rules
evidence.effect: fewer wasted reads, re-runs and long outputs (expected, not measured)

evidence.setting: repository context files (AGENTS.md style), not short behavior rules
evidence.effect: no general gain in task success and over 20% more inference cost on average

killTest.hypothesis: The working rules lower cost per accepted task
killTest.pass: Wins: cost-ratio interval below 1 and pass-rate difference interval above -5 points
killTest.budget: 40 tasks x 2 arms x 2 runs; 2 weeks
killTest.ifFails: Off by default; kept as an option
killTest.scheduled: v8.0 maintainer reference bench, first run after release

maintenance: Owned text, maintained in this repository.
